cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
수양 사제라 딜은 약하지만
필드 남작 퀘스트…
한 마리씩 유인해서 잡자.
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter over-the-shoulder view of a 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon Night Elf priestess crouching cautiously on the left beside a small snowy rock ledge on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. She holds her golden Holy Cross staff ready with a faint translucent golden Power Word: Shield bubble shimmering around her as she carefully pulls one hostile Syndicate guard toward her with a tiny glowing wand spark, while a bulky armored Baron boss and other guards patrol in the distant right. Determined sweating expression with focused eyes, minimal snow patch under their feet.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
15분 만에 남작 처치…!
이제 퀘스트 템만
루팅하면 드디어 끝이야!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle side shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background showing the exhausted Night Elf priestess kneeling happily on the left with her Holy Cross staff tucked neatly on her back. Sweat drops fly from her brow as she eagerly reaches both empty hands toward a cute non-gore defeated Baron boss slumped flat on a minimal snowy stone patch on the right, a sparkling golden loot pouch glowing beside him. Relieved sparkling eyes and triumphant smile.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
어, 사제님 방금 위상
바뀐 거 아니에요?
시체 증발하고 몹 다 떴는데?
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle medium shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background as a shimmering translucent phase-shift ripple sweeps across the minimal snowy ground. On the left, the Night Elf priestess stares down in sudden confusion with her staff on her back as the Baron's body and loot bag dissolve into vanishing sparkles while angry Syndicate guards pop back up behind them. On the right, a mischievous Gnome rogue with daggers sheathed at her belt emerges from a small Vanish smoke puff and points casually at the empty snow.

Dramatic tight close-up reaction cut on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background focusing on the Night Elf priestess in the center-left frozen in absolute soulless shock, her face pale with blank wide eyes, tiny trembling pupils, and shaking hands still held mid-air over empty white space. Dark comedic gloom lines fall over her head while silhouettes of freshly respawned guards loom menacingly behind her on the minimal snowy floor. The Gnome rogue peeks silently from the far right edge with a deadpan raised eyebrow.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
내 15분! 수양 사제로
한 땀 한 땀 잡았는데!
이 겜 진짜 접는다!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic tilted action angle on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background showing the Night Elf priestess on the left clutching her head in pure rage and despair with her Holy Cross staff stowed on her back. Her mouth is wide open in a comedic scream with exaggerated cartoon veins and flying tears as the respawned Baron and guards charge from the right across a tiny snow patch.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
진짜 접으실 거면
창고 골드랑 물약 좀
저 주고 가시죠?
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium side-profile shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background with a minimal snow patch underfoot. On the left, the exhausted Night Elf priestess glares blankly while starting to channel a glowing blue Hearthstone swirl in her hands, her staff tucked on her back and a tied brown leather gold pouch with shiny round gold coins hanging at her waist. On the right, the Gnome rogue with daggers sheathed at her belt leans forward cheerfully with sparkling eyes and an outstretched empty palm.
